To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the alkali-treated palm leaf stalk fiber-based polymer composite shows better properties than untreated ones.
the alkali treatment of palm leaf stalk fiber reinforced polymer composite improves the mechanical properties.
the alkali-treated palm/glass sandwich fiber reinforced polymer composite has a higher mechanical property than untreated palm/glass composite.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of ecofriendly polymer composite with natural fiber as reinforcement.
the development of a novel polymer composite with palm leaf stalk fibers as reinforcement and coconut shell filler as nano filler.
the use of alkali treated palm/glass sandwich fiber reinforced polymer composite for fabrication of automotive parts.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the alkali treatment is a very effective method to enhance the properties of natural fibers.
the palm leaf stalk fiber is a potential reinforcement for polymer composites.
the alkali treatment of palm leaf stalk fiber reinforced polymer composites has been proved to be an effective technique to improve the mechanical properties of the composites.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, the natural fibers are eco friendly, cost effective and easily available.
the alkali treatment of the palm leaf stalk fibers enhances their properties and hence can be used as reinforcement in polymer composites.
the palm leaf stalk fibers treated with potassium permaganate solution shows improved properties than untreated one.
The main takeaway from our work is that
palm fibers are a sustainable resource for polymer composite manufacturing and can be used in the automotive sector to reduce the cost of production.
we have developed a new eco friendly composite with natural fiber and glass fiber sandwiched with nano coconut shell filled polyester resin.
the palm leaf stalk fiber can be a potential reinforcement for the fabrication of polymer based composite materials.
